description: Illustrative demo data. 56 synthetic cases in 10 campaigns modelled on publicly reported Indian scam types (sources in docs/DATASET.md). Every identifier is synthetic: demo UPI handles (zzdemo.*@okdemo), demo Telegram handles (@zzdemo_*), reserved domains (example.com/net/org), wallets from eval/synthetic-wallets.json (random discarded keys). Reporter IPs are documentation addresses (198.51.100.0/24) turned into fingerprints through the real HMAC path. Seeded by web/scripts/seed-india-cases.ts.
